Laboratory.cell: National High Magnetic Field Laboratory (NHMFL), Florida State University (stated section 2.4)
Laboratory.value: National High Magnetic Field Laboratory (NHMFL), Florida State University (stated section 2.4)

Sampling Unit Type.cell: 12 mL sub-sample (aliquot) of an acidified seawater sample -- "Acidified seawater samples ... were sub-sampled (12 mL) into clean 30 mL FEP Teflon bottles. The 12 mL aliquots were spiked"; "standard additions ... were added to individual 12 mL sub-samples of the same sample"; "Standard additions of Co and Mn were performed on a further four aliquots (1 mL) of the elution acid"
Sampling Unit Type.value: 12 mL sub-sample (aliquot) of an acidified seawater sample -- "Acidified seawater samples ... were sub-sampled (12 mL) into clean 30 mL FEP Teflon bottles. The 12 mL aliquots were spiked"; "standard additions ... were added to individual 12 mL sub-samples of the same sample"; "Standard additions of Co and Mn were performed on a further four aliquots (1 mL) of the elution acid"

Sample Preparation Method.cell: Open-ocean seawater; off-line pre-concentration using Toyopearl AF-Chelate-650M chelating resin (stated section 2.2)
Sample Preparation Method.value: Open-ocean seawater; off-line pre-concentration using Toyopearl AF-Chelate-650M chelating resin (stated section 2.2)

Digestion Acid(s).cell: N/A — seawater; pre-concentration by chelation; no acid digestion

Digestion Vessel Type.cell: N/A — no digestion vessel; seawater pre-concentration

Final Solution Matrix.cell: all: 1.0 M HNO3 — 'extracted trace elements were eluted with 1 mL of 1.0 M Q-HNO3' (§2.2)

Chromatographic Separation Applied.cell: Toyopearl AF-Chelate-650M chelating resin (pre-concentration from seawater; stated section 2.2)
Chromatographic Separation Applied.value: Toyopearl AF-Chelate-650M chelating resin (pre-concentration from seawater; stated section 2.2)

Instrument Manufacturer.cell: Thermo Fisher Scientific -- "a Thermo-Finnigan Element I (E1) HR-ICP-MS"; "Instrument ThermoFinnigan Element1"
Instrument Manufacturer.value: Thermo Fisher Scientific -- "a Thermo-Finnigan Element I (E1) HR-ICP-MS"; "Instrument ThermoFinnigan Element1"

Instrument Model.cell: Thermo Finnigan Element I (E1) HR-ICP-MS (stated section 2.4)
Instrument Model.value: Thermo Finnigan Element I (E1) HR-ICP-MS (stated section 2.4)

Interface Cone Configuration.cell: Ni/Cu sampler (Spectron Inc.) + Ni skimmer (Spectron Inc.; Table 2)
Interface Cone Configuration.value: Ni/Cu sampler (Spectron Inc.) + Ni skimmer (Spectron Inc.; Table 2)

Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.cell: PFA Teflon Savillex 100 mL with internal baffle (Table 2)
Spray Chamber Type and Cooling Temperatu.value: PFA Teflon Savillex 100 mL with internal baffle (Table 2)

Analytical Mode.cell: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "Nebuliser PFA microflow (PFA-100), Elemental Scientific"; "Nebuliser sample uptake rate 150 uL min-1"; "Autosampler CETAC ASX-100". The flow-injection manifold of sec 2.2 is the offline pre-concentration step, not the ICP-MS introduction: "prevented the online coupling of the flow injection system directly to an ICP-MS" [sec 2.3]
Analytical Mode.value: Solution nebulisation (continuous) -- "Nebuliser PFA microflow (PFA-100), Elemental Scientific"; "Nebuliser sample uptake rate 150 uL min-1"; "Autosampler CETAC ASX-100". The flow-injection manifold of sec 2.2 is the offline pre-concentration step, not the ICP-MS introduction: "prevented the online coupling of the flow injection system directly to an ICP-MS" [sec 2.3]

ICP Tuning.cell: "At the start of each day, prior to any sample analysis, the instrument was first tuned to produce maximum sensitivity and stability while also maintaining low oxide formation ... using a 5ppb solution of In"; "Further tuning using a 5ppb solution of Fe in the medium resolution mode ensured maximum separation of the 56Fe peak from the 40Ar16O peak"; oxide formation "typically below 5%", above 10% causing problems
ICP Tuning.value: "At the start of each day, prior to any sample analysis, the instrument was first tuned to produce maximum sensitivity and stability while also maintaining low oxide formation ... using a 5ppb solution of In"; "Further tuning using a 5ppb solution of Fe in the medium resolution mode ensured maximum separation of the 56Fe peak from the 40Ar16O peak"; oxide formation "typically below 5%", above 10% causing problems

Target Species.cell: Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Cd, Pb — abstract; Table 1

Reported Variables and Units.cell: Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu, Zn, Cd, Pb (nM, dissolved) — dissolved concentrations in seawater

Monitored Masses.key: defines: monitored property per target species
Monitored Masses.cell: 56Fe, 57Fe → Fe; 60Ni, 62Ni → Ni; 63Cu, 65Cu → Cu; 66Zn, 68Zn → Zn; 110Cd, 111Cd → Cd; 207Pb, 208Pb → Pb; 55Mn → Mn; 59Co → Co; 95Mo → none — the spike and reference isotopes of Table 1, ⁵⁵Mn and ⁵⁶Fe named in §2.4, and ⁹⁵Mo counted for the MoO⁺ correction; Co is monoisotopic

Mass Resolution Assignment.cell: all: medium resolution (R = 4000) for Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu and Zn, low resolution (R = 300) for Cd and Pb — §2.4

value.value: medium resolution (R = 4000) for Mn, Fe, Co, Ni, Cu and Zn, low resolution (R = 300) for Cd and Pb

Internal Standard Element.cell: all: none — isotope dilution for Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Cd and Pb, standard additions for Co and Mn (§2.5)

Oxide Production Method and Threshold.cell: In (5 ppb) used for LR tuning; oxide rate typically <5% (stated section 2.4)
Oxide Production Method and Threshold.value: In (5 ppb) used for LR tuning; oxide rate typically <5% (stated section 2.4)

Drift Correction Method.cell: Elution acid, an enriched-isotope standard and a natural-abundance commercial standard measured every 10–12 samples — 'to assess instrument drift and mass bias' (§2.4)
Drift Correction Method.value: Elution acid, an enriched-isotope standard and a natural-abundance commercial standard measured every 10–12 samples

Calibration Strategy per Target Species.cell: Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Cd, Pb: isotope dilution; Mn, Co: standard addition — standard additions of 50, 100 and 150 µL of the mixed Co and Mn solution to 12 mL sub-samples (§2.3, §2.5)

Blank / Background Correction Method.cell: All sample concentrations corrected for the ammonium acetate buffer and the extraction procedure (flow manifold, chelating resin, elution acid), which includes the ICP-MS background — §2.5
Blank / Background Correction Method.value: All sample concentrations corrected for the ammonium acetate buffer and the extraction procedure (flow manifold, chelating resin, elution acid), which includes the ICP-MS background

Spectral Interference Corrections Applie.cell: Y — MoO⁺ on ¹¹⁰Cd and ¹¹¹Cd corrected by counting ⁹⁵Mo (§2.4); Fe and Mn interferences resolved in medium resolution

Interference Correction Method.cell: 110Cd, 111Cd: 95Mo counted in all analyses, with slopes from linear regressions of 95Mo/110Cd and 95Mo/111Cd on Cd-free Mo standards (1–100 nM) run at the start and end of each session; 56Fe, 55Mn: resolved in medium resolution; other: N — §2.4

value.value: 95Mo counted in all analyses, with slopes from linear regressions of 95Mo/110Cd and 95Mo/111Cd on Cd-free Mo standards (1–100 nM) run at the start and end of each session

Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.cell: Standard isotope dilution equation (de Jong et al.), with a per-element mass-bias factor applied to the sample isotope ratios — §2.5
Isotope Dilution Data Reduction Method.value: Standard isotope dilution equation (de Jong et al.), with a per-element mass-bias factor applied to the sample isotope ratios

Uncertainty Level.cell: Mixed and each stated: "Mean blank +/- 1 S.D. (pmoles)"; "The precision is calculated as the percent relative standard deviation (%RSD) (n = 3)" [Table 4 footnote]; "95% confidence limit" [Table 6 caption]
Uncertainty Level.value: Mixed and each stated: "Mean blank +/- 1 S.D. (pmoles)"; "The precision is calculated as the percent relative standard deviation (%RSD) (n = 3)" [Table 4 footnote]; "95% confidence limit" [Table 6 caption]

Calibration Factor and Determination Met.cell: Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Cd, Pb: mass-bias correction factor, measured over true natural isotopic ratio, from replicate analyses of a commercial ICP standard (High Purity Standards); Mn, Co: slopes of the standard-addition curves; other: N — §2.5

value.value: mass-bias correction factor, measured over true natural isotopic ratio, from replicate analyses of a commercial ICP standard (High Purity Standards)

Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.cell: Partially -- "The blank solutions were analysed at least three times on the ICP-MS"; "parallel triplicate samples"; n = 3 for reference materials and n = 5 for the GEOTRACES samples. No acceptance or rejection rule stated
Analysis Inclusion and Rejection Criteri.value: Partially -- "The blank solutions were analysed at least three times on the ICP-MS"; "parallel triplicate samples"; n = 3 for reference materials and n = 5 for the GEOTRACES samples. No acceptance or rejection rule stated

Combination Method.cell: all: mean of replicate analyses, and average slope of the standard additions — 'Mean blank ± 1S.D.'; 'Average slopes resulting from the regression analysis of Co and Mn standard additions'

value.value: mean of replicate analyses, and average slope of the standard additions

Constants and Reference Values Used.cell: Partially -- "A mass bias correction factor for each of the six elements was calculated from the measured natural isotopic ratio divided by the true natural isotopic ratio". The true natural isotopic ratios used, and their source, are not stated
Constants and Reference Values Used.value: Partially -- "A mass bias correction factor for each of the six elements was calculated from the measured natural isotopic ratio divided by the true natural isotopic ratio". The true natural isotopic ratios used, and their source, are not stated

Primary Calibration Standard Name.cell: all [Fe, Ni, Cu, Zn, Cd, Pb: enriched isotope spike (57Fe, 62Ni, 65Cu, 68Zn, 111Cd, 207Pb) calibrated against ICP High Purity Standards; Mn, Co: mixed Co and Mn standard-addition solution from Spectrosol AA standards] — §2.1

value.value: enriched isotope spike (57Fe, 62Ni, 65Cu, 68Zn, 111Cd, 207Pb) calibrated against ICP High Purity Standards
mixed Co and Mn standard-addition solution from Spectrosol AA standards

Secondary Reference Materials.cell: NASS-5; SAFe S1; SAFe D2 — NASS-5 (NRCC certified open-ocean seawater) and the SAFe inter-comparison samples (§2.6)

Detection Limit.cell: Mn: 0.007; Fe: 0.021; Co: 0.002; Ni: 0.026; Cu: 0.007; Zn: 0.005; Cd: 0.0006; Pb: 0.0002 — nM, 3 SD, for the extraction of a 12 mL sample (Table 5)

Detection Limit Method.cell: all: 3 SD of the reagent blank — Table 5, for a 12 mL sample

Internal (Within-Measurement) Analytical.key: sample > sampling unit x reported property

Within-Session Analytical Precision and.cell: NASS-5, SAFe S1, SAFe D2 [all: 95% confidence limit, n = 3] — Table 6

Analytical Accuracy and Assessment Metho.cell: NASS-5, SAFe S1, SAFe D2 [all: agreement with the NASS-5 certified and SAFe consensus values] — Table 6

value.value: agreement with the NASS-5 certified and SAFe consensus values

Additional Notes.cell: Off-line pre-concentration on Toyopearl AF-Chelate-650M resin; enriched isotope spikes added before extraction; standard additions for Mn and Co (§2.2–2.3)
Additional Notes.value: Off-line pre-concentration on Toyopearl AF-Chelate-650M resin; enriched isotope spikes added before extraction; standard additions for Mn and Co (§2.2–2.3)
